This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 25, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Funerals held for four Palestinians killed in deadly West Bank shooting. Overnight funerals were held for four Palestinians killed near Nablus. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

2. Israel arrests dozens of Palestinians in West Bank amid settler attacks. Military crackdown follows a shooting that killed four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

3. Baby rescued after Israeli settlers set home on fire amid raids. A baby was rescued by her family after her home was set on fire by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

4. Reclaiming stolen childhoods: swimming classes resume in Gaza after three years of war. In sea pools built with sandbags and rubble, Amjed Tantesh gives traumatised children brief respite from their daily lives Swimming classes have started again in Gaza after three years of war, with hundreds of children learning to float, doggy paddle and take their first strokes in five makeshift sea pools built from sandbags and rubble. This was reported by The Guardian.

5. Born too soon: Premature babies fight for survival in Gaza. Israel's genocidal war on Gaza is causing a surge in premature births and endangering mothers' health. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 25, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
